description: A large elapsed time display, readable from across the room, counting hours, minutes, seconds and milliseconds, with three alarms that fire a pulse at a set time

params.text: Starts the timer, and starts it again from where it stopped
Sets the timer back to zero

inputs.text: A trigger starts the timer, and starts it again from where it stopped
A trigger sets the timer back to zero

outputs.text: A copy of each start, for starting other timers at the same moment
A copy of each reset, for resetting other timers at the same moment
A pulse when the timer reaches the time set for that alarm

notes: each alarm's hours, minutes and seconds are set on its own displays rather than with knobs
menu: Restart Timer on open — sets the timer running from zero whenever the patch is loaded
